remaining_reviews.reason: All 51 entries reviewed. Current 26q3 SoCs inherited instead of old full copies; real Series-2 I2C/NOR/BURTC contracts and 47 profile loads pass. ADC/TrustZone/timer/LF compensation and diagnostic limits remain explicit.

remaining_reviews.finding: HFXO calibration uses configured 38.4/39/40MHz; all 14 configurations pass (8 baseline subcase failures). Legacy 33280Hz SYSRTC profile is explicitly retained only for comparison pending vendor replay; an uncompensated profile is supplied.

Recovered the lab staged-CCM token-table working patch. 26q3 already implements staged-CCM and context save; retain that implementation and passing upstream vectors. Vendor encrypted-traffic replay remains pending.

Recovered lab Infrastructure 43a2158d plus three working files and original DLL. EUSART4 synchronous completion was additionally ported and regressed. Exact old DLL build provenance and runtime-loaded LG subclass source remain unproven.

Recovered the exact OpenThread 21c9cdd and OTBR 08d546a objects on chen@lab and pushed them to our forks. Recovered native chip-tool and OT CLI; isolated rootless runner passes real Ltech PASE. OT leader precheck still fails; portable source builds and full commissioning remain pending.

remaining_reviews.reason: Ported MG21 SoC/board/DeviceFamily and opt-in HFXO unlock. Four HFXO and five synthetic platform tests pass; real firmware boot and legacy model approximations remain unqualified. Historical tlib fix is already migrated and ISA-regressed.
